description: Switch thrown under a standing train, which then leaves facing through it (#289 review 2b): an EU07 with three coaches stands cold across zwr01 on td.scn, the locomotive on track 2, the last coaches over the switch, which is set to track 2. 5 s after the start the switch is thrown to track 1; then the driver gets the order to go, into the station, facing through the switch. Every vehicle has to keep to the line of a track.

xfail: #289 review 2b, as before the stack (TrkFoll reverted in c268673c): the axles that stood on the switch leave it by the way it is set to now, so the second coach runs with one bogie on track 2 and the other on track 1, 4.6 m apart, its body 2.3 m off both, with nothing derailed or broken; and the AI scans its route from the last vehicle through the switch as now set, reads the signals of track 1 while it runs on track 2, and its head is counted past the exit signal of track 1 at stop
